subject.title: improve(qa): align Telegram coverage with startup behavior

question: Should the taxonomy-selection parent be accepted as the prerequisite contract before this Telegram evidence branch is rebased and considered for merge?
rationale: The child’s scenario-selection behavior intentionally depends on an open parent branch, and only maintainers can accept that parent contract and sequencing.

options.title: Land parent, then refresh child
options.body: Review the parent first, then rebase this branch onto the resulting main head and require exact-head QA and CI evidence.

options.title: Review the stack as one change
options.body: Accept the coupled taxonomy and Telegram evidence design together, while still requiring a final merged-stack CI result before landing.

recommendation.title: Land parent, then refresh child
recommendation.body: Review the parent first, then rebase this branch onto the resulting main head and require exact-head QA and CI evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the recent contributor for both the parent selection refactor and this Telegram-specific follow-up.
